title: Pre-Schwarzian and Schwarzian norm estimates for certain classes of analytic and harmonic mappings
summary: Let $\mathcal{A}$ denote the class of all analytic functions $f$ in the unit disk $\mathbb{D}:=\{z\in\mathbb{C}: |z| 0, ~\text{and}~|θ|<\fracπ{2},\] and investigate the Schwarzian derivative and Schwarzian norm for functions $f$ belonging to the class $\mathcal{C}_θ(γ)$. We establish sharp estimates for the Schwarzian norm $\|S_f\|$ of functions $f$ in the class $\mathcal{C}_θ(γ)$ and derive univalence criteria using both pre-Schwarzian and Schwarzian norm estimates.
